chain_words.nuance: needs care, but is not very hard
tests your skills in a positive way
requires a lot of time, effort or attention
very hard and requiring great effort over a long period

explanation: These words all describe something that is not easy. The degree of difficulty rises from a small problem that needs care to an exhausting task that drains all of your energy.

usage_notes.difference: 'Challenging' suggests something that tests your ability in an interesting way; 'demanding' stresses how much time, effort or attention something requires.
